authority: Externally supplied model judgments through existing independently reviewed PRs

reads.candidates: Keyword-overlap candidates or paginated enumeration by canonical kind; selection reasons, never semantic identity
reads.context: Record/group neighbourhood cards for comparison, linkage or reassessment; no behavior execution
reads.research_state: Portable question neighbourhood, support chains and preserved producer review history; default byte-bounded JSON text pages, explicit complete export
reads.passage: Native text field or complete record/operation JSON in byte-bounded character ranges
reads.assessments: Immutable supplied grades and reassessments, with explicit current result
reads.changes: Canonical changes between pinned packages plus new model operations
reads.lineage: Existing source/evidence lineage cues as paginated cards; lineage-flag expands members
reads.recent: Whole recent-maintenance input in one response: window with its new sources and touched questions, every added claim with its support, compare_with targets by shared source, shared question or capped keyword overlap with existing links and decision references, shape (generated whole-model counts) and previous_brief (the last nightly brief's text, or null)

read_bounds.continuation: next_offset at the same pinned build

research_state_interface.selector: canonical Q ID, or exact preserved external reference plus submission JSON pointer
research_state_interface.pagination: character offsets in serialized portable JSON; same build, selection and state_sha256
research_state_interface.complete: explicit local full object; no pagination cap
research_state_interface.research_validity: preserved producer declarations only; missing or unsupported coverage is unknown

write_interface: scripts/world_control.py RUN-ID-or-M-ID --decisions FILE [--apply]; default dry run

comparison: supersedes: current pair operation reference or null
reassessment: predecessors: claim ID to current reassessment reference or null
linkage: record: complete existing graph-schema dependency/coupling record
previous_sha256: current relationship digest or null for new

writer_captured_fields: previous_uncertainty: claim ID to previous grade for reassessments

references.group: Any original canonical member ID remains an address; the display representative is derived
